notes: P5(a) force-diagram wording is checked against the full theoretical question paper page8, which explicitly requires gravitational, net and picker force vectors.
Original answer dots, calculation space, continuation page7, filled black non-response cells, tables, micrographs and P5/B5 plotting frames remain.

Formula fragments keep their original individual source fonts, sizes and relative glyph positions. The wrapped source Ka2 expression is rejoined on a common baseline without changing either piece internally.

Source Latin/math embedded font programs are retained. Korean text uses Noto Sans KR companions because source fonts lack Korean glyphs. Scanned figure-label fonts are matched optically, not claimed as recovered source font files.

The source Helvetica is unembedded Base14. Its translated Latin headers/footers use the exact Nimbus Sans Regular CFF program MuPDF uses for that source Helvetica. This is an explicit Base14 substitution, not a recovered organizer font file.
Alpha/Beta/Delta/Gamma/Theta, X/Y/v, question codes and TT identifiers are retained to match the original question paper.
This is the complete separate official theoretical answer booklet. It does not establish possession of the distinct 29-page practical yellow answer booklet.
